item.name: Breakables Mastery
item.bestFor: Long farming sessions and loot grinding
item.notablePerks: Better loot, faster respawns, longer flags, and mini-chest bonuses
item.level99: +100% respawn speed, +21 flag slots, +50% mini-chest spawn chance, 2x flag duration, 5x mini-chest loot, plus Breakables Mastery Cape
item.grindStyle: Natural AFK or active farming grind
item.shortcutNote: Usually worth leveling through normal farming unless you need the final loot perks quickly.
item.description: Breakables Mastery rewards the core PS99 loop of smashing objects for coins, diamonds, and drops. It is one of the easiest masteries to progress while you are already farming.

item.name: Eggs Mastery
item.bestFor: Players who hatch constantly or chase pet variants
item.notablePerks: Cheaper eggs, faster hatch animation, bonus egg slots, and golden/rainbow hatch chances
item.level99: +5 bonus egg slots, 30% cheaper eggs, and Eggs Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: A strong shortcut target for hatch-focused players because normal eggs give very slow progress.
item.description: Eggs Mastery is built for players who spend long sessions hatching. Its best perks reduce hatch friction and make large hatch sessions cheaper and faster.

item.name: Pets Mastery
item.bestFor: Players converting, fusing, or enrolling large pet stacks
item.notablePerks: Faster machines, better gold/rainbow chances, lower pet requirements, and better Daycare rewards
item.level99: -2 pets required for golding and rainbowing, 2x Daycare speed and diamond loot, plus Pets Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Useful for players who hate pet conversion chores, but fusing can also train it over time.
item.description: Pets Mastery improves the systems that turn pet stacks into stronger or more useful pets. It overlaps with Fuse Mastery because fusing pets can train both tracks.

item.name: Potions Mastery
item.bestFor: Players who use boost timers and craft higher potion tiers
item.notablePerks: Longer potion duration, cheaper upgrades, higher tier access, auto-claiming, and multi-type upgrading
item.level99: 2x potion duration, upgrade multiple potion types at once, plus Potions Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Good shortcut value if you use high-tier potions often and want the duration or upgrade perks.
item.description: Potions Mastery makes timed boosts easier to use and upgrade. It is strongest for players who regularly farm with potion timers active.

item.name: Enchants Mastery
item.notablePerks: Cheaper upgrades, higher tier equip/craft access, stronger enchant power, and multi-type upgrading
item.level99: 25% power from enchants, upgrade multiple enchant types at once, plus Enchants Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Strong for loadout-focused players because tier access and enchant power affect many farming setups.
item.description: Enchants Mastery supports book upgrades and stronger loadouts. It matters most once your farming setup depends on higher-tier enchant books.

item.name: Fruits Mastery
item.bestFor: Players who keep fruit buffs active
item.notablePerks: Longer fruit duration, cheaper rainbow fruit crafting, larger queues, and automatic fruit use
item.level99: Auto-eat normal and shiny fruit, reduced rainbow crafting cost, 30-fruit buff cap, plus Fruit Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Better as a shortcut target if you actively use fruit buffs; casual players can train it gradually.
item.description: Fruits Mastery turns fruit from a small consumable habit into a stronger passive buff system. Its late perks are mostly about longer buffs and less manual eating.

item.name: Economy Mastery
item.bestFor: Players who use vending machines and merchants for items
item.notablePerks: Buy-all vending option, lower prices, faster restocks, more vending stock, and better merchant luck
item.level99: -50% merchant prices, automatic coin vending purchases, free coin vending items, plus Economy Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Usually easy to train if you run merchant and vending routes often.
item.description: Economy Mastery improves the value of shops and vending machines. It is a practical grind for players who already sweep the map for items.

item.name: Keys Mastery
item.bestFor: Players opening key chests or managing key stacks
item.notablePerks: Chance to keep keys, better chest loot, combine-all keys, and free key chances while combining
item.level99: +25% loot from Fantasy, Crystal, Tech, and Void Chests, 2x free-key chances when combining, plus Keys Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Use shortcuts only if key opening is a major part of your routine or you dislike saving key stacks.
item.description: Keys Mastery is for players who open key chests and combine key pieces. Its value depends on how often you actually use key-based reward routes.

item.name: Superior Chests Mastery
item.bestFor: Players farming Superior Mini Chest spawns and loot
item.notablePerks: Higher Superior Chest spawn chance and multiplied Superior Chest loot
item.level99: +50% Superior Chest spawn chance, 5x Superior Chest loot, plus Superior Chests Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: A focused shortcut target only if Superior Chest farming is part of your setup.
item.description: Superior Chests Mastery is narrow but useful for players built around mini-chest spawns. It improves both how often the chests appear and how much they pay out.

item.name: Gifts Mastery
item.bestFor: Players opening reward items and collecting free gifts
item.notablePerks: Double-loot chances, faster Free Gift timers, better Charm Stone loot, and auto-claiming
item.level99: Faster Free Gifts, better Charm Stone loot, stronger double-loot chances, plus Gifts Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Useful if you open many saved gifts; otherwise it can grow slowly through normal rewards.
item.description: Gifts Mastery improves the reward items that pile up during normal play. It is especially useful when you open bundles, mini chests, and free gifts in bulk.

item.name: Boost Exchange Mastery
item.bestFor: Players who regularly buy boost effects
item.notablePerks: Cheaper boosts, stronger boosts, longer boost duration, and automatic boost buying
item.level99: Boosts are 40% more effective plus Boost Exchange Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Only prioritize if Boost Exchange is already part of your farming routine.
item.description: Boost Exchange Mastery is tied to buying temporary boost effects with Millionaire Bucks. It is strongest for players who plan farming sessions around those boosts.

item.name: Fishing Mastery
item.bestFor: Players chasing Deep Pool rewards and fishing Huge chances
item.notablePerks: Faster casting and catching, Deep Pool access, better Deep Pool Huge chance, larger bobber, and rainbow rod chance
item.level99: +50% chance to catch a Huge from Deep Pools, 2x rainbow rod conversion chance, plus Fishing Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Good shortcut candidate if you dislike fishing but want Deep Pool perks.
item.description: Fishing Mastery is a focused minigame track. It does not train from every fishing-like activity, so the source minigames matter.

item.name: Digging Mastery
item.bestFor: Players who farm digging rewards and minigame Huge chances
item.notablePerks: Better Digsite chest drops, more diamonds, better chest find odds, Mastery Chest access, Huge chance, and rainbow shovel chance
item.level99: +35% Digsite chest diamonds, +50% drops, +50% Mastery Chest Huge chance, 2x rainbow shovel chance, plus Digging Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: A shortcut makes sense only if you want digging rewards but do not enjoy the minigame loop.
item.description: Digging Mastery is another focused minigame track. It is most useful when you spend real time in the digging loop instead of only passing through it.

item.name: Fuse Mastery
item.bestFor: Players turning pet stacks into better results
item.notablePerks: Chance for two pets, better fuse results, faster animation, guaranteed gold/rainbow results at high levels
item.level99: 5% chance to get two pets and minimum fuse lowered to 2 pets, plus Fuse Mastery Cape
item.shortcutNote: Fusing also trains Pets Mastery, so active fusers may not need to spend a shortcut here first.
item.description: Fuse Mastery improves the Fuse Machine itself. It rewards players who regularly turn extra pets into stronger results.
